Our approach

Useful details. Clearer choices.

AI Directory is being built as a practical reference for people choosing tools for real work.

A directory organized around your task

We group tools by the work they support, from drafting and research to design and automation. Tools can belong to multiple categories, but every tool has one canonical profile so information stays together.

What a listing should tell you

Every published profile should explain the main capabilities, intended audience, practical use cases, and meaningful limitations. Pricing models, free plans, free trials, platform support, and API access are recorded separately.

Evidence before claims

Profiles distinguish supplied research from independently verified information. Where the research includes a verification date, it is attributed to that source. Undated records are identified, and no hands-on testing is implied. Unknown information stays marked as unverified. We do not invent reviews, star ratings, popularity rankings, or product claims.

A growing collection

The directory currently contains 105 listed tools, including 85 complete profiles. Listings are added one at a time. Comparisons and more focused guides will follow when there is enough reviewed material to make them useful.

Commercial relationships

No paid placements or affiliate links are currently included. If that changes, the relevant listings will clearly disclose the relationship.

Choose with current information

AI products change quickly. Check a listing’s source links and verification date, then confirm important details on the official website.
